test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following pairs of ‘Ruler – Ruling period’ is correctly matched?

I. Sher Shah Suri – 1540-1545

II. Akbar – 1556-1605
solution:
The correct answer is **Both I and II**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__Sher Shah Suri:__

__
 
• Sher Shah Suri was the 6th ruler__ of the Suri Empire.
 
• He was a Pathan from Bihar who defeated the Mughal emperor Humayun in (1530-1540) and also in (1555-1556) and founded the Suri Empire in Northern India.​
 
• He ruled from __1540-1545.__&l
